mentions.name: Hitomi
mentions.description: A native, cross-platform log/data analyzer that opens large CSV files, logs, and even command stdout in constant time using an incremental combinatorial parser that processes chunked input from a stream, so the UI is ready as soon as the first chunk is parsed. Features include a two-mode filter (a convenient UI mode plus an extensible DSL for complex cases), a timeline-mode scrollbar for log and time-series analysis, auto-fitting column widths, and no web bloat. Available for Windows and Linux, with macOS in progress.
mentions.problem: Opening large CSV files is frustrating, and Excel has many quirks when working with CSV files.
mentions.source_excerpt:
This starts from my frustration when opening large CSV files, but later evolved to a log/data analyzer that loads arbitrary format in constant time (O(1)).

https://github.com/Verticalysis/Hitomi
